entries.mem0ai/mem0: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that serves as a universal memory layer for AI agents. It supports multi-level memory for User, Session, and Agent states through temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that provides memory, RAG, and user profiles via a single API. It features a custom vector graph engine and supports multi-modal extraction for various file types.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that utilizes viking:// URIs for deterministic context manipulation. It employs a tiered L0/L1/L2 loading architecture to optimize task completion.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: A specialized brain for the Hermes Agent that provides synthesized answers with citations and gap analysis. It creates typed edges to build a self-wiring knowledge graph using PGLite for local deployment.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A memory system designed for long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows. It is available via Python and Node.js client SDKs and supports Docker-based deployment.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A memory library for constructing stateful agents that supports peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It is available as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent memory provider that manages context trees using git-like version control. It features a 5-tier retrieval system and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system that utilizes a single SQLite database for storage. It supports MCP for integration with Cursor, Claude Code, and Windsurf.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that provides filesystem-first traces, reports, and datasets. It supports multiple agent providers and includes CLI tools for task investigation.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a SQLite-backed message store. It builds a depth-aware summary DAG to provide compacted history for the agent.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend for Honcho that enables private cross-session memory for the Hermes Agent. It supports OpenAI-compatible LLM providers and local inference servers.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems that stores memory as plain-text YAML engrams. It supports hierarchical scoping for global and project-specific knowledge.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and memory layer that provides portable state across various agents and MCP clients. It includes a dashboard for inspecting and repairing memory.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device memory and context engine that operates without cloud dependencies. It utilizes hybrid retrieval with BM25 and vector search and captures decisions using a local GGUF observer model.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization plugin that reduces prefill latency and token usage through block reordering and deduplication. It is compatible with the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: A durable, file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search. It is a local-first architecture that does not require a vector database or embeddings.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: A self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall with scoring reasons for every result. It includes contradiction tracking and a loop to identify knowledge gaps.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to provide evidence packets to the agent.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses local-first storage via SQLite-vec and GGUF models.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system that uses semantic search and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia and codebases with OCR support.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A tool to reduce prompt token overhead by using local BM25 tool ranking. It is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 and includes a dashboard for tracking token savings.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: A memory and context layer that resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens. It supports local-first and air-gap environments.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: A long-term, cross-project memory system that stores information as inspectable Markdown files. It uses DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin that uses an embedded graph database and importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search and named graph relationships.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that supports real, immediate event deletion. It provides an audit trace of prefetch operations via a trace.jsonl log.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: A memory provider that offers cross-agent recall with semantic search and provenance tracking. It supports session snapshots and TTL for durable state storage.
entries.piprail/piprail: An SDK and MCP server that enables AI agents to pay for API usage using various blockchain families. It integrates with Hermes, OpenClaw, and elizaOS.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A memory plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for searching, manual storage, and result reranking.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: A plugin providing private local code memory for repositories. It supports semantic search, file reads, and grounded Q&A via slash commands.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: A memory provider offering 17 tools for management and knowledge graph traversal. It uses hybrid search and provides automatic context checkpointing.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: An AI-native memory system featuring AES-256-GCM encryption at rest. It supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall with MinHash deduplication.

entries.obra/superpowers: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology utilizing a subagent-driven-development process. It includes skills for brainstorming and planning while emphasizing red/green TDD and YAGNI.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first open-source design and prototyping system that supports HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4 exports. It is compatible with various coding agents and OpenAI-compatible endpoints, including Hermes Agent.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A collection of 817 production-grade cybersecurity skills mapped to six major frameworks, including MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. These skills cover 29 security domains and are compatible with Hermes Agent.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: A tool that generates editable.drawio files from natural language descriptions or Mermaid text. It supports 11 diagram type presets and includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing and rewriting tool designed to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using 57 pattern categories. It is compatible with Hermes and supports Rewrite, Detect, and Edit modes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: A system for collective skill evolution that provides automated deduplication and quality improvement. It enables unified skill libraries across multiple agents and devices for shared user teams.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform skills library compatible with Claude Code and agentskills.io-compatible agents. It includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: A trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce providing adjudication for deals, escrow, and dispute resolution. It includes natural-language mandates and various protocol skills like x402 payments.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation for detected patterns.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Implements the Agent Skills open specification for Pydantic AI to provide type-safe support. It reduces token usage through the progressive disclosure of skill metadata.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: A suite of skills for extracting YouTube transcripts, captions, and timestamps without using yt-dlp. It supports video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: A skill set that enables Hermes Agent to write custom analytical prompts via the /prism-scan command. It provides seven pre-built prisms for tasks like resilience, optimization, and simulation.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A workflow skill that converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents. It features Lite and Full modes along with a spec review gate using evaluation models.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A harness for long-running AI agents that provides structured memory and a three-level work model. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards backed by file or SQLite storage.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: A literate programming skill that weaves code and documentation into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the document.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: A plugin providing self-memory and replacement models through cross-instance shared memory via markdown files. It automates the capture of high-value decisions and outcomes for fine-tuning.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: An implementation of the agentskills.io specification for interacting with the Oracle network and smart contracts. It supports CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds integration.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official image generation skills for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It provides standardized prompting guidelines and API integration patterns for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: A tool that converts repositories, documentation, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It generates version-pinned instruction files with provenance via citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification. It features a Python SkilldockClient, a CLI, and commerce features using TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: A skill for autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks. It provides real-time progress tracking, decision logging, and built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental metadata discovery.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: A skill that enables Hermes Agent to manage Nextcloud files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts. It communicates securely over HTTPS using standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: A local-first workflow language for AI implemented as a single Rust binary. It provides static auditing for cost, permissions, and types, along with hash-chained execution receipts.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer intelligent skill retrieval system that uses semantic embeddings and hard triggers. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: A plugin that rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like CLI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites based on model family and preserves non-English prompts.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review skill that uses three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases and integration risks. It is a read-only tool that generates suppression rules via an MCP server.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C# /.NET implementation of agentskills.io featuring MCP integration. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automatic registration of skill directories.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent code simplification skill using a three-agent swarm for hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It includes a risk-tiered triage system for safe code modifications.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: A skill implementing multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol and a Python goal engine.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing, searching, and one-click installation of skills. It implements the Agentic Resource Discovery v0.9 specification and features federated search.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: A CLI and MCP server that allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and plugins.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: A skill compatible with Hermes Agent and agentskills.io that automates payments for HTTP 402 responses. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols using USDC.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: A multi-scale Chinese news briefing generator that produces structured reports from global to street level. It includes quality gates and AI analysis for core conclusions.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated automatically on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This is a zero-install desktop GUI for Windows that requires no admin rights. It features an integrated workflow engine for automated multi-step pipelines and includes a toolset with TTS, Music, and ComfyUI.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project provides an automated Termux-based installer and guide for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer state safety for persistent HERMES_HOME storage and supports configurable gateway mode.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project sandboxes Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement via NVIDIA OpenShell. It provides kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows building specific Hermes tags using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This Nix package and NixOS module enables reproducible Hermes deployment through declarative configuration. It supports hybrid skill management and secure secrets integration via systemd EnvironmentFiles and sops-nix.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane allows for the deployment, monitoring, and operation of OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via a REST API, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances from a single web application. It manages separate workspaces and identities, hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables the autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework decomposes financial trading tasks into specialized roles, including fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It supports multiple LLM providers alongside local Ollama models.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration system manages task assignment, execution review, and completion receipts. It offers a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, and REST API, complemented by a memory browser and relationship graph.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI and mobile-friendly web dashboard for managing multiple coding agents, such as Claude Code, OpenCode, and Gemini CLI. It utilizes Docker sandboxing and git worktrees to ensure agent isolation.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single VPS agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for security auditing, registry management, and VPS setup.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from individual agents to automated teams through an orchestrator-to-specialist task delegation pattern. It features bundled skills for backup management, security auditing, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This tool enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using multiple model providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work via a Kanban board. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure roles. It employs a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols and provides a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and provides a real-time dashboard for scoreboard metrics and code visualization.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: This delegation system routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code to prevent parent context pollution. It enforces safety through configurable timeouts and output character limits.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This project provides a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph that serves as an MCP server for multiple coding agents. It supports languages including TypeScript, Python, Go, Rust, Java, and C# to reduce token usage and tool calls through automatic project indexing.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A cross-platform CLI tool designed to track token usage across various AI coding clients such as Hermes, Claude Code, and Gemini. Version 2 includes a native Rust TUI for monitoring consumption.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect API traffic, including system prompts and tool calls, from agents like Hermes and Cursor. It supports exporting local traces into self-contained HTML viewers for inspection.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent and GitHub Copilot.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate applications. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows capable of autonomous execution on laptops or a VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: A community-driven CLI tool used to customize the Hermes terminal UI with various themes. Users can configure banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based settings.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via the Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable handles and Solana-based payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively within Claude Code without external processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools for RL training and inference.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes integrated session management and a research desk.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings for Hermes Agent. It provides 40+ pre-configured skills for research, devops, and finance via an automated installation process.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A TAW Agent framework that enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configuration. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents while supporting project-local tools and memories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It offers three scalable deployment tiers and supports 29 community plugins.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A static linter that uses regex and structural heuristics to score AI agent configs, system prompts, and tool descriptions. It operates without requiring model or API calls and supports multiple file formats including YAML and Markdown.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: A migration tool designed to move SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides self-healing capabilities for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a beta Hermes plugin that exports telemetry for tool calls and API requests to monitor health and token intelligence.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides an all-in-one interface for managing multiple agentic tools including Claude Code, Gemini CLI, and Hermes Agent.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork app for macOS, Windows, and Linux that supports various agent CLIs. It features a built-in agent engine with file access and automates the creation of Word, Excel, and PPT documents.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface that provides full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. It utilizes a three-panel layout featuring chat and a workspace file browser.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for guided installation and provider setup. It provides a GUI for managing chat, sessions, and tools across multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A web dashboard that provides multi-platform AI chat, session management, and usage analytics. It includes a file browser, web terminal, and unified configuration for channels like Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring a chat interface, terminal, and memory browser. It includes an integrated skills manager, MCP catalog, and an inspector panel with tmux-backed workers.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that enables direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs alongside an embedded terminal for system repair.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust. It supports Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime with LaTeX and Markdown rendering.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to local or remote Hermes Agent runtimes. It supports full-page workspace sessions via Hermes Web.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard providing a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and agent status panel. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS application that serves as a session browser and agent cockpit. It provides live per-session quota burn-rate tracking and operates locally with no telemetry or remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace designed for running Hermes Agent on SSH hosts and Orgo cloud computers. It features one-click automated installation and integrated WebRTC voice mode using OpenAI Realtime.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative terminal dashboard built with OpenTUI that consolidates Hermes Agent chat, sessions, and configuration. It includes integrated kanban boards and an extensible Eikon avatar system.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard designed for Telegram Mini App v2.0. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable, no-install Windows desktop application that requires no admin rights or Docker. It includes 100 tools, a workflow engine for multi-step automation, and support for local models via LM Studio.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent assistance. It features real-time log streaming, a task tracking dashboard, and management tools for MCP servers, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time dashboards for session activity and cost tracking, alongside inspection tools for skill source code and environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for skills and MCP servers, as well as isolated profile management.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and a native interface for model switching.
